components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit code that is valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner opts in with sharesHousehold and an existing owner shares the household; every member carries the same value. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: "5f2b3c1a-8d4e-3f6a-9b2c-1d0e7a5f4c33"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed on creation. Starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality (region), the REGION segment of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city yields a region.
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's business day (a bulk sign-up), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key consolidating all duplicate detection, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: "+61412345678||"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented soft (possible) duplicate detection for `POST /api/owners`. A new owner that isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone is still created and flagged.

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner` model** — added persisted fields `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) with getters/setters, plus their `@Column` mappings.

2. **Schema SQL** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added `possible_duplicate BOOLEAN` and `possible_duplicate_of INTEGER` columns. Tests run under the `hsqldb` profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to exist in `schema.sql`.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the two read-only fields to the Owner schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries them.

4. **`AssignPossibleDuplicate`** (new OfficeFloor function) — scans existing owners for one with the same normalized `lastName` and `postcode` but a different E.164 telephone; sets `possibleDuplicate` true and `possibleDuplicateOf` to the matching owner id (earliest by id if several), otherwise `possibleDuplicate` false. It runs within the create transaction, after `RejectDuplicateIdentity` (hard duplicates already rejected) and before `SaveOwner` (so it can't match itself).

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `assignPossibleDuplicate` into the pipeline between `rejectDuplicateIdentity` and `assignHouseholdSize`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`.

6. **`OwnerMapper`** — the DTO mapping picks up the two fields by name automatically; added `@Mapping(ignore = true)` for them on `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (they're server-computed, not client input), consistent with the other assigned fields.

The check reads back correctly through `GET /api/owners/{id}` because the flags are persisted on the entity (like `namesakeCount`/`householdSize`) and mapped straight into the DTO.
